Median static level · 2013-2026

Wisconsin Groundwater

Three aquifer systems interpolated beneath the land surface, from municipal well records held by the Wisconsin DNR. Each well contributes the median of its full record, so this is typical conditions over 13 years rather than any single date.

Well readout

Hover a well marker to read its record. Drag to orbit, scroll to zoom, shift-drag to pan.

Positions are provisional. 1,682 of these wells are located only to their PLSS section, a one-square-mile block whose internal relief runs about 94 ft. Read this as a regional surface, not a site-specific one.

Head (water-table elevation) is fitted against land-surface elevation per band, then the residual is interpolated by inverse distance and added back. Fitted slope b reports how closely each system tracks topography: near 1.0 is an unconfined water table, well below 1.0 is confinement. Depth to water is read off as the gap to the land surface.
